firstone-framework.name: FirstOne Framework
firstone-framework.side.client.tooltip: Changes only your own game. Set here, works on every server, even servers without the mod.
firstone-framework.side.server.tooltip: Changes game rules run by the server. Set here for singleplayer; a server with the mod uses its own files in config/firstone-framework/.
firstone-framework.config.reset.title: Reset %s?
firstone-framework.config.reset.message: Every option on this screen goes back to its default value.
firstone-framework.config.reset.message_: Every option of every category goes back to its default value.
firstone-framework.config.server_notice: Server rules: changes apply to singleplayer only
A dedicated server uses its own file: config/firstone-framework/%s
firstone-framework.animatium.name: Animatium
firstone-framework.animatium.description: 1.7.10 animations and feel: items, hand, sneaking, mobs and effects
firstone-framework.animatium.category.it: Where held items (first and third person) and items on the ground are drawn, like 1.7.10
firstone-framework.animatium.category.ha: How your hand moves when you use, drop or switch items
firstone-framework.animatium.category.sn: How sneaking players look and fit: their eyes, hitbox and pose
firstone-framework.animatium.category.en: How other players and mobs move, turn their body and swing
firstone-framework.animatium.category.ef: The camera tilt and red tint when hurt, the dust of a landing, and the hit effects added in 1.9
firstone-framework.animatium.old_sneak.t: 1.7.10 sneaking: the hitbox keeps its full height (no walking under 1.5-block gaps) and the eyes drop only slightly, with 1.7.10 timing. The crosshair always aims where the camera looks.
firstone-framework.animatium.old_item_dr: 1.7.10 dropping: the arm never swings, and dropping the last item lowers it and raises the empty hand.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_reeq: 1.7.10 held item: no dip after attacking, no re-equip when only the durability of the held item changes, and a held item that runs out (picked up or moved in a screen, thrown, the last one eaten) goes down before the empty hand comes up.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_hurt: 1.7.10 hurt camera: the screen always tilts the same way when you are hurt, wherever the hit came from. The Damage Tilt accessibility option still sets how strong it is.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_firs: 1.7.10 held items: items, tools and blocks in your hand sit where 1.7.10 drew them, with the 1.7.10 bow, eating and drinking poses, and the fishing rod turned around. Items 1.7.10 did not have (shield, trident, crossbow...) keep their normal look.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_thir: 1.7.10 held items seen from outside: players, zombies and skeletons hold items, tools, bows and blocks where 1.7.10 drew them, and a player blocking with a sword raises the arm like 1.7.10. Items 1.7.10 did not have and newer mobs keep their normal look.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_grou: 1.7.10 items on the ground: blocks spin a little lower, flat items spin with Fancy graphics and always face you without spinning with Fast graphics (no glint), and stacks show copies like 1.7.10. Items 1.7.10 did not have keep their normal look.
firstone-framework.animatium.resource_pa: Items whose model a resource pack or another mod changes keep that look instead of the 1.7.10 placement.
firstone-framework.animatium.old_item_us: 1.7.10 right-click: no arm swing when throwing or using items (ender pearl, egg, snowball...) or right-clicking entities. The hand only dips when the item count changes.
firstone-framework.animatium.no_sweep_ef: Hides the sweep attack particle and mutes the sweep sound (added in 1.9). Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.no_damage_i: Hides the dark heart particles shown when hitting a mob (added in 1.9). Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.no_attack_s: Mutes the player attack sounds added in 1.9 (crit, strong, weak, knockback, no damage, sweep). Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_enti: 1.7.10 movement of other entities: positions snap to 1/32 block and only update after moving 0.125 block or turning 5.6 degrees, velocity only updates after changing by 0.02, and heads turn instantly. This is the stepping look of 1.7.10. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_body: 1.7.10 body turning: players and old-AI mobs turn sideways when walking backwards and can look up to 75 degrees away from their body. Other mobs use the 1.7.10 body helper. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_snea: 1.7.10 sneaking model: shown whenever shift is held (also while flying), only the legs and head move, and the model is lowered like 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_zomb: 1.7.10 arms: zombies and skeletons always hold their arms straight forward (skeletons point the bow forward instead of only aiming when attacking), with the 1.7.10 attack swing.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_mob_: 1.7.10 client physics: mobs are also moved by your client with their own velocity, so getting hit, knocked back or pushed looks jerky like 1.7.10 instead of gliding smoothly. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_hurt: 1.7.10 hurt color: hurt and dying entities, armor included, get the bright 1.7.10 red (40% red at the block brightness, which follows day and night, without the extra darkening of 1.21.1). Held items and blocks stay untinted, as in 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_fall: 1.7.10 landing dust: when you, another player or a mob lands from a fall, the dust of the block flies out in a flat ring from the middle of the block and slides along the ground, instead of the 1.21.1 puff around the feet. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_mob_: 1.7.10 mob attacks: mobs only swing their arm when they hold an item, so an empty-handed zombie does not raise its arms when it attacks. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.appearance.name: Appearance
firstone-framework.appearance.descriptio: Game icon, window title and 1.7.10 loading screens
firstone-framework.appearance.icon.toolt: Click to switch between Minecraft's icon and the PNG files in the icons folder.
firstone-framework.appearance.icons_fold: Put PNG files in config/firstone-framework/appearance/icons/ and reopen this screen to see them.
firstone-framework.appearance.window_tit: Text of the game window title. Leave empty for Minecraft's default title.
firstone-framework.appearance.confirm_qu: Ask before the window's close button (X) quits the game. Cancel is the default answer, so Enter or Esc keeps playing. The in-game Quit Game button never asks.
firstone-framework.appearance.legacy_sta: Like 1.7.10, the game starts on a white screen with the logo in the middle, without a progress bar or fading. Also when resource packs load again (after the Resource Packs screen, F3+T, a server's pack).
firstone-framework.appearance.startup_lo: Click to switch between the game's logo (Mojang Studios, in red) and the PNG files in the logos folder. A logo from the folder is drawn at most 256 wide, like the 1.7.10 logo; the file is read when you choose it.
firstone-framework.appearance.logos_fold: Put PNG files in config/firstone-framework/appearance/logos/ and reopen this screen to see them.
firstone-framework.appearance.legacy_loa: Like 1.7.10, loading screens have the dark dirt background (opening a world, connecting, changing dimension, saving), a new world shows "Loading world" and "Building terrain" instead of the chunk map, and "Downloading terrain" shows while a world or dimension arrives. The dirt follows your resource packs.
The 1.7.10 progress bar (gray, filling in green) under "Building terrain", with the real progress of the world. 1.7.10 did not show it there, so it is off by default.
firstone-framework.appearance.category.w: The game icon, the window title and asking before the window closes
firstone-framework.appearance.category.l: The 1.7.10 startup screen and loading screens, their logo and progress bars
firstone-framework.appearance.legacy_sta: A progress bar under the logo of the startup screen, in the style of the 1.7.10 loading bar (gray, filling in green), showing how far the resources are loaded. 1.7.10 had no bar there, so it is off by default.
firstone-framework.appearance.legacy_mes: Like 1.7.10, messages have no box: "Loading world" while a world opens or is made, nothing while the world is saved on leaving (1.7.10 showed only the background), other messages as they are.
firstone-framework.appearance.startup_ba: White like 1.7.10, or black, which is easier on the eyes. The game's logo stays red; a logo from the folder is drawn as it is (dark parts of it may be hard to see on black).
firstone-framework.cosmetics.name: Cosmetics
firstone-framework.cosmetics.description: Your own death, item break and music disc effects
firstone-framework.cosmetics.folder.tool: Put your files in config/firstone-framework/cosmetics/: death/ and item_break/ (particle/0.png, 1.png… and sound.ogg), music_discs/ (any .ogg songs). Images: PNG up to 256 px. Sounds: OGG.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.reload.tool: Loads the files again after you add, change or remove them (same as F3+T).
firstone-framework.cosmetics.status.none: No files: the game's own effect is used
firstone-framework.cosmetics.status.tool: What is in the folder now. Press Reload on the Cosmetics screen after changing files.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.name: Death Effect
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.descr: Particles and sound when a dead body disappears
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.enabl: When a dead body disappears, show your frames (death/particle/) and play your sound (death/sound.ogg) instead of the game's puff of smoke. Without files, the game's effect is kept.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.playe: Use it when a player dies, yourself included.
Use it when a mob dies.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.parti: How many particles appear. The game uses 20.
How fast the particles spread out; 1.00x is the game's speed.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.sound: Start the sound this long before the body disappears (the body lies down for 1 second first), so a sound with a build-up hits when the particles appear. 0.00 s: starts with the particles.
Particles and sound when a tool, weapon or armor piece breaks

When a tool, weapon or armor piece breaks, show your frames (item_break/particle/) and play your sound (item_break/sound.ogg) instead of the game's item pieces and crack sound. Each one without a file stays the game's.
Use it when an item of a player breaks, yours included.
Use it when an item of a mob breaks.
How many particles appear. The game uses 5.
Skip this much of the start of the sound, so its loudest part plays right when the item breaks (a break cannot be known in advance, so the sound cannot start early).
firstone-framework.cosmetics.music_discs: Choose a song file for each disc
Discs play the song chosen below. The song stops when the disc's own time is over, as in the game.
Click to switch between the disc's own song and the .ogg files of music_discs/. A song can be chosen for several discs. New files need Reload before they play.
Play songs as mono from the jukebox, like the game's discs: they fade with distance. Off: a stereo song plays in stereo, the same everywhere in range.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.parti: Particle size; 1.00x is the game's size.
How long the particles stay; 1.00x is the game's duration. The frames play from first to last over this time.
firstone-framework.cosmetics.death.sound: Volume of your sound. The game's volume slider of the entity's category (players, hostile or friendly creatures) also applies.

Play your sound as mono, so you hear where it comes from (left, right, distance; front, back, up and down with the game's Directional Audio on). Off: a stereo file plays the same in both ears from everywhere.
Particle size; 1.00x is the game's size.
How long the particles stay; 1.00x is the game's duration. The frames play from first to last over this time.
Volume of your sound. The game's volume slider of the entity's category (players, hostile or friendly creatures) also applies.

Play your sound as mono, so you hear where it comes from (left, right, distance; front, back, up and down with the game's Directional Audio on). Off: a stereo file plays the same in both ears from everywhere.
firstone-framework.legacy_hud.name: Legacy HUD
firstone-framework.legacy_hud.hide_effec: No effect icons in the top-right corner, like 1.7.10. Effects still work and are still listed in the inventory.
firstone-framework.legacy_hud.legacy_inv: Like 1.7.10: when the inventory or the creative inventory opens while you have effects, the window moves right and the effects are listed on its left. While the recipe book is open, the normal layout is kept.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.name: Pack Manager
firstone-framework.pack_manager.descript: Resource pack presets, dragging and search
A button above the Selected list of the Resource Packs screen shows the preset you use ("Preset: Custom" when your packs match none) and opens the presets. A preset keeps a list of packs in order; applying it fills the screen with those packs, and pressing Done loads them as if you had picked them by hand.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.drag_to_: Drag a pack by its name: within Selected to change the order, from Available to a place in Selected to turn it on there, or back to Available to turn it off. The arrow buttons keep working. Also in the data pack screens.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.pack_sea: A search box above the pack lists: both lists show only the packs whose name or file name contains the text. While searching, packs cannot be moved up or down. Also in the data pack screens.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.open_pre: Opens the Resource Packs screen with the presets on top. Done in the Resource Packs screen loads the packs and comes back here.
These packs were made for another version of Minecraft and may not work correctly: %s
The preset will be gone for good. The packs themselves are not touched.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.ico: The picture in the presets list: the icon of one of its packs, or Auto for the icons of its top packs
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.edi: Choose and order the packs of this preset in the Resource Packs screen. Done there puts them into this form; the packs you use now do not change.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.use: Replaces the packs of this preset with the packs selected in the Resource Packs screen now (asks first)
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.rem: Removes the packs whose files are gone from this preset (asks first). While they stay, they are skipped when the preset is applied and work again when their files come back.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.ask_befo: While your packs match a preset, the first change in the Resource Packs screen (turning a pack on or off, moving or dropping it) asks first, because it makes your packs custom. The preset itself never changes.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.preset_b: Your packs match the preset %s. Click to see the presets.
Your packs match no preset. Click to see the presets, or to save these packs as a preset.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.leave_pr: Your packs will become a custom list. The preset itself does not change, and you can apply it again any time.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit_pac: The preset keeps the packs it had.
No presets yet. Press New from Current to save the packs you use now as a preset.
The packs you use now are not saved as a preset. Applying replaces them in the Resource Packs screen; to keep them, save them first with New from Current.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.dis: The changes to this preset are not saved.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.use: Replace the packs of this preset?
Its packs (%s) are replaced by the packs you use now (%s). Nothing is saved until you press Save or Create.
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.rem: These packs leave the preset: %s. Nothing is saved until you press Save or Create.
Changed since the preset was saved (skipped until accepted in Edit): %s
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.lis: Not in the resource pack folder
firstone-framework.pack_manager.edit.rev: Some files are not the ones this preset was saved with. Choose which new files the preset keeps; until then they are skipped when the preset is applied.
These files are not the ones this preset was saved with. Tick the ones it should keep; the others stay skipped when the preset is applied.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.name: Legacy Vehicles
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.categ: How boats steer, ride, look and sound
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.legac: Drive boats like 1.7.10: the boat goes where you look when you press forward (no turning with left/right), speeds up slowly to its top speed, turns toward where it moves and floats higher. No paddling sounds. Works on any server. Your boat is also pushed when other boats, players or mobs bump into it, like 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.ice_b: With Legacy Handling, boats slide on ice, packed ice and blue ice as fast as in 1.21.1 and slow down gradually after leaving it, still steered like 1.7.10 (1.7.10 boats could not slide on ice).
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.legac: In boats, look all around freely (the boat does not turn you), and in a wooden boat sit a little lower and behind the middle when alone, like 1.7.10. Two passengers, chest boats and rafts keep the normal seats.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.mobs_: Mobs in boats turn their head and body like when they stand on the ground (without shaking), instead of always facing the front of the boat with the head twisted far to the side. Where they look stays as the server says; works on any server.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.legac: While paddling a boat, your hand and held item stay in view and you can still attack and use items, like 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.boat_: Water splashes around fast boats, like 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.legac: Draw wooden boats with the flat 1.7.10 model, without paddles, covered with the planks of the boat's wood.
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.resou: When a resource pack changes a boat's texture, keep the normal model for that boat so the pack's look is not lost (its texture only fits the normal model).
firstone-framework.legacy_vehicles.hide_: Hide the paddles of boats drawn with the normal model: chest boats, bamboo rafts, and wooden boats when Legacy Model is off.
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.name: Combat Tweaks
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.descrip: Pre-1.9 combat: no attack cooldown, no sweeping
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.no_atta: Every hit deals full damage right away, like before 1.9: no waiting for the attack cooldown.
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.disable: Attacks no longer damage entities around the target, like before 1.9.
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.sweepin: Sweeping still works with a Sweeping Edge weapon. Only used while Disable Sweeping Attack is on.
firstone-framework.mob_tweaks.name: Mob Tweaks
firstone-framework.mob_tweaks.descriptio: Mobs that cannot spoil the world
firstone-framework.mob_tweaks.enderman_b: Endermen still pick up and carry blocks, but only for show: the block stays where it was, nothing is placed when they put it down, and nothing drops when they die. Such an enderman can despawn.
firstone-framework.mob_tweaks.nether_spa: Piglins and hoglins spawn by themselves only where the light from blocks is at most the limit below, so lit paths stay free of them. Spawners, spawn eggs, bastions and breeding are not limited. Zombified piglins are not changed.
The brightest light from blocks where piglins and hoglins still spawn by themselves (a torch gives 14, next to it 13, and so on).
firstone-framework.mob_tweaks.nether_att: In the dark, piglins and hoglins attack on sight as usual. Where you stand in light from blocks above the limit below, they attack only while angry at you: for the anger time after you hit one of them (its kind joins in), after a piglin sees you open a chest or mine gold, or after one last chased you in the dark. Bastion mobs, piglin brutes and zombified piglins are not changed.
The brightest light from blocks where you stand that piglins and hoglins still attack you on sight.
firstone-framework.mob_tweaks.nether_ang: How long piglins and hoglins stay angry at you while you stand in the light (zombified piglins stay angry 20 to 39 seconds).
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.name: Legacy Mechanics
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.desc: 1.7.10 server rules: combat, players, drops, boats and enchanting
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.cate: Knockback of hits and attacks, and sword blocking
The hitbox of crouching players and natural health regeneration
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.lega: Legacy Knockback

1.7.10 knockback when hit: players get the full knockback (1.21 loses about half of it), always pushed 0.4 up (also in the air), knockback resistance is a chance to ignore knockback, arrows push away from the shooter, and creeper/TNT explosions also knock back.
Legacy Attack Knockback
1.7.10 extra knockback from players and mobs: sprinting always adds knockback (no full charge needed), applied as a push with 0.1 upward motion, not reduced by knockback resistance.
Legacy Crouch Hitbox
1.7.10 sneaking on the server: crouching players keep the full 1.8-block hitbox and 1.62 eye height. Players without the mod cannot crouch into 1.5-block gaps.
Legacy Regeneration

1.7.10 health regeneration: with food at 18 or more, health comes back 1 point every 4 seconds. The fast healing from saturation after eating (1.21.1) is gone. Works in singleplayer and on servers with this mod.
Legacy Sword Blocking

1.7.10 sword blocking: hold right click with a sword to block, taking about half the damage (not from fire, falling, drowning or magic) while walking slowly. Works in singleplayer and on servers with this mod; players with the mod see you block. A shield, food or bow in the off hand is used instead.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.cate: Where dropped items and experience orbs appear and how they scatter, and items thrown when a screen closes
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.lega: Legacy Item Drops

1.7.10 item drops: items dropped by mobs, animals, players and vehicles appear where 1.7.10 put them, so drops at a mob's feet bounce out of the ground and scatter like in 1.7.10. Items stuck in a block are pushed out the 1.7.10 way.
Legacy Experience

1.7.10 experience orbs (the amount stays the same): a killed mob drops its orbs when its body disappears, and orbs scatter out of the ground, sink in water, fly to your eyes and stay separate like in 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.drop: When you close a screen, the items left in the crafting grid, the enchanting table, the anvil, a villager's trade slots or another work block, and the item on your cursor, are thrown out in front of you like 1.7.10, instead of going back into your inventory.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.cate: Boats breaking when they crash, and boats coasting without a driver
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.lega: Legacy Boat Breaking

1.7.10 boats: a wooden boat that hits a wall while going fast breaks into 3 planks and 2 sticks, and boats remove the snow layers they go through. Wooden boats always; chest boats and rafts with the option below.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.brea: Chest boats and bamboo rafts (not in 1.7.10) break the same way. A chest boat drops its chest and everything in it.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.boat: Boats on ice, packed ice or blue ice do not break when they hit something, so ice roads stay usable.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.lega: Legacy Boat Coasting

Like 1.7.10, a boat keeps going after its driver gets out and slows down slowly (1.21.1 stops it at once), standing on a boat pushes it away from where you stand, and boats with someone inside are pushed when boats, players or mobs bump into them. Empty boats float as high as in 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.cate: The levels enchanting takes, a new roll for every item, and clues for a price
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.lega: Legacy Enchant Cost
1.7.10 enchanting cost: enchanting takes as many levels as the number on the line you choose (up to 30), not 1 to 3. The level you need and the lapis lazuli used stay the same.
Legacy Enchant Reroll

1.7.10 enchanting rolls: every item you put into the enchanting table gets new levels and enchantments, and the lines show no clue. The chances stay exactly the same as without this option, where the roll stays the same until you enchant something.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.paid: Players with this mod get a "?" button left of the enchanting table: it takes the lapis lazuli and levels below and shows the clue of each line, which the item then really gets. Pressed again, it makes a new roll with new clues. Players without the mod never see clues. Works with Legacy Enchant Reroll.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.ench: Lapis lazuli one look at the clues takes. The slot must hold 3 more, for the enchanting itself.
Levels one look at the clues takes.
Shows the clue of each line for %s Lapis Lazuli and %s Levels
Shows the clue of each line for %s Lapis Lazuli
Press again for a new roll with new clues
Put in an item to enchant
